description: Dependency updates for ViscoSuite. The runner and its token live in the project ops/renovate; the rules below say what it proposes here.

customManagers.description: DockerfileContractTest repeats the base image tag of the Dockerfiles; it must move in the same merge request.

packageRules.description: Patch updates: one merge request a week.
Minor updates: a second merge request a week.
A new major version is listed in the dashboard issue. Tick it there to get a merge request.
No digest pinning and no commit-date updates in this repository.
The base image's Tomcat and the Tomcat libraries the runner compiles and tests against move together, in a merge request of their own: it is the one bump that changes what every instance runs on.
HAPI FHIR is one version for the store and the healthcare pack (hapi.version); ViscoForge's pack must follow it by hand.

Look Maven versions up on Maven Central itself, not through the repositories the poms name: the caching proxy answers with the version list it last fetched, which gave a Tomcat merge request with three different versions (2026-11-27). Our own artifacts are held, so nothing needs the other repositories.
Our own Frank!Framework build, Ladybug (it moves with that build) and our own artifacts and images move by their own release steps.
Must equal the Lemma engine version the ViscoFoundry portal pins. Move both together by hand.
